evidence: Changes SOCKS5 proxy connection logic in src/netbase.cpp, directly governing outbound peer connection establishment over Tor.
rationale: Fixes connection failures to 20–30% of IPv6 peers when routing outbound traffic through Tor SOCKS5 proxies. Due to an upstream Tor exit relay parsing bug, compressed IPv6 addresses absorb the port number, causing repeated "general failure" errors and dropping connections to seed and addrman peers.
